# Privacy Policy

Last updated: 26 October 2026

CVTara ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect when you use cvtara.com, why we collect it, who we share it with and the choices you have. It is written to be consistent with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Information Technology Act, 2000.

## 1. Data we collect

- **Account details:** name, email address, password (stored only as a secure hash) and, if you add it, phone number and city.
- **Profile and document content:** your profession, experience level, resumes, cover letters, job descriptions you paste and applications you track.
- **Purchase records:** plan, amount, date and payment reference. Card, UPI and bank details are handled by our payment partners (Razorpay and PhonePe) and are never stored by us.
- **Usage and device data:** pages visited, features used and basic technical data, so we can run and improve the service. Optional analytics run only if you accept analytics cookies.
- **Support messages:** what you send to support@cvtara.com or through the contact form, including any screenshot you attach.
- **Optional recent-activity notice:** at checkout you may tick a box to let the site show your first name and city (nothing else) in a small “recently started” notice. It is off unless you tick it, and you can ask us to stop showing it at any time by writing to support@cvtara.com.

## 2. Why we use your data

We use your data to create and secure your account, store and export your documents, process payments and give you access, send service emails (for example receipts, access reminders and password resets), provide support, prevent fraud and abuse, and improve CVTara. We send marketing emails only if you agree, and you can withdraw consent at any time. If you agree to marketing emails, we may use the college, target role and most recent employer in your resume to choose which emails are relevant to you. We never share your resume with colleges or employers for marketing, and we only report college totals, never individual students.

## 3. Who we share data with

We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with service providers who help us run CVTara, such as payment processing (Razorpay and PhonePe), email delivery, hosting and, when you choose to use them, CVTara team writing help, Tara Expert Review and Profile Boost (a text-processing provider) and the full grammar check (LanguageTool). They may use the data only to provide their service to us. We may disclose data if required by law or to protect rights and safety.

## 4. Your resume content

Your resumes and letters are yours. We do not publish them and do not use them to train public models. CVTara team writing help, when you choose to use it, sends only the text you paste or pick to our text-processing provider to prepare a suggestion. When you buy Tara Expert Review or Profile Boost, the text of your saved resume (your primary resume, or the one you edited last), your target role and the profile details you send us are processed by the same provider, so the CVTara team can prepare your review or profile; the result is stored with your order and emailed to you. Our provider does not use this text to train its models, and may process it outside India. Suggestions and reviews are shown to you for review and never change your documents on their own. The basic writing check runs on our own server and sends your text nowhere. The full grammar check, when it is switched on and you press it, sends the text of that document to LanguageTool to check it.

## 5. Retention

We keep your account and documents while your account is active. Purchase and tax records are retained as required by Indian law. When you delete your account, your personal data and documents are erased and purchase records are detached from your identity.

## 6. Your rights

You can access and correct your information in your account, download a copy of your data, withdraw consent for optional processing, and delete your account from Account settings. You can also write to us to exercise any right under applicable law, including the right to nominate someone to act for you and the right to grievance redressal.

## 7. Security

We use encrypted connections, hashed passwords, access controls and monitoring. No system is completely secure, so please use a strong, unique password.

## 8. Children

CVTara is for adults. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18.

## 9. Cookies

We use essential cookies for sign-in and security. Optional analytics cookies load only after you accept them.

## 10. Grievance and contact

For privacy questions or complaints, write to our grievance contact at **support@cvtara.com** (CVTara, Bangalore, Karnataka, India). We aim to acknowledge requests within 72 hours and resolve them within 30 days.

## 11. Changes

If we change this policy we will update the date above and, for material changes, notify you by email or in the product.

## Cookies and device identifier

CVTara sets a session cookie to keep you signed in and a long-lived random device identifier on sign-in pages to detect repeated or abusive sign-ups. It contains no personal details. If you accept analytics, Google Analytics may set its own identifiers. You can clear cookies in your browser at any time; some features may stop working.

These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of CVTara (cvtara.com) and its resume, cover-letter, ATS-match and application-tracking tools. By creating an account or using the service you agree to them. If you do not agree, please do not use CVTara.

You must be at least 18 years old and provide accurate information when you register. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account. Tell us immediately at support@cvtara.com if you suspect unauthorised use.

Access to downloads and plan features is provided through paid plans and add-on packs shown on our pricing page. Prices are in Indian rupees and are charged once for the stated access period. We work to keep CVTara available but do not promise uninterrupted service. We may improve, change or retire features, and we will update these Terms when needed. Continued use after an update means you accept the updated Terms.

CVTara is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, our total liability for any claim relating to the service is limited to the amount you paid for the plan in the 12 months before the claim, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss.

## 10. Refunds

You can get a full refund within 7 days of purchase if nothing paid for has been used, once per customer, as set out in our Refund Policy. After that, payments are final.

## 11. Governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at Bengaluru, Karnataka have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to any rights you have as a consumer under applicable law.

CVTara, Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Email: support@cvtara.com
legal.refund:
# Refund Policy

Last updated: 20 October 2026

CVTara packages are paid once and never renew automatically. If you change your mind, you can get your money back within 7 days, as long as you have not used what you paid for.

## 1. The 7-day refund

You get a **full refund** if you ask within **7 days of your purchase** and **nothing paid for has been used**. Used means any of these:

- a clean (watermark-free) download of a resume or cover letter,
- a paid ATS Match scan,
- a tailored resume made with the package,
- for Profile Boost, our team has started work on it,
- for Tara Expert Review, the review has been written. The CVTara team starts on it soon after payment, so in practice it can be refunded only while it is still waiting to be written.

Building, editing, saving and previewing with the watermark never count as use.

## 2. Once per customer

Each customer can get one refund. A Quick Download that was credited towards a Job Hunt or Pro upgrade cannot be refunded separately.

## 3. How to ask

Open **Account → Purchase history** and press **Request refund** next to the order. The button only shows when the order can be refunded. You can also write to **support@cvtara.com** from your registered email address with your order number.

## 4. When the money arrives

Approved refunds go back to the original payment method (UPI, card or net banking). Banks usually take **5–7 working days** to show it. Access from the refunded package ends when the refund is processed. Wallet credit used on the order is returned to your wallet.

## 5. When a refund is not possible

After 7 days, or once something paid for has been used, the payment is final. We do not offer pro-rata refunds for unused days or credits.

## 6. Referral rewards

A referral reward is earned only after a friend's purchase passes this 7-day window without a refund. Rewards linked to a payment that is refunded, reversed or disputed do not count.

## 7. Questions

Write to **support@cvtara.com**. CVTara, Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

# About CVTara

CVTara helps Indian job seekers apply with confidence. We build resumes and cover letters that recruiting systems can read and people want to read, and we show you what each job asks for that your resume does not yet prove.

## Who is behind it

CVTara is built by an experienced HR team in Bangalore. We have spent years reading resumes, screening candidates and sitting on hiring panels. We built CVTara to give every job seeker the clarity that recruiters wish every application had.

## What you can do here

- **Start the easy way.** Upload the resume you already have (Word, PDF or text) or pick one of our ATS-friendly templates.
- **Keep one primary resume.** It is your master copy. Edit it once, and create a tailored version for any job in one click.
- **See what is missing.** Add the job as a PDF or text and get a full report of the requirements your resume does not yet cover, with what to fix.
- **Write a matching cover letter.** Same story, same details, no blank page.
- **Stay on top of every application.** Each resume you prepare goes into your tracker, with up to three friendly reminders to update its status.

## How we work

- **Truthful content.** CVTara never invents experience for you. You control every word and decide what to send.
- **Plain pricing.** You pay once for the days shown. Plans never renew automatically. If you change your mind within 7 days and have not used it, you get a full refund. You can also build, preview and run a few checks free first.
- **Honest results.** The ATS match is an estimate of how well your resume backs each requirement. It is not a real employer ATS result, and nobody can guarantee an interview.
- **Your data stays yours.** We use it to run the service. We do not sell it. Read the [Privacy Policy](/privacy.html).

## Where we are

We operate from Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and support job seekers across the country. Questions are answered by our own team at **support@cvtara.com**, Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 18:00 IST. You can also use the [contact page](/contact.html).
